# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Texture that transforms every bite

Mobile Image

## Formulate with our versatile ingredient solutions that help you exceed consumer expectations for
## amazing taste and better nutrition

Ingredion is your ideal partner in developing the future of food, empowering you to create consumer
preferred products that offer exceptional eating experiences with the on-trend benefits they desire.

### Unlock consumer-preferred sweet taste without artificial sweeteners

New PureCircle Clean Taste Solubility Solution (CTSS) is a patented technology offering improved
taste performance, cleaner labels and is 100 times more soluble than Reb M.

[Learn more][2]

[Picture 1118121461]

We can also help you accelerate your sustainability initiatives with our tailored ESG solutions
specific to food and beverage manufacturers. Ingredion's sustainable innovation and regenerative
agriculture practices deliver unmatched, [industry-leading sustainability results][3] that help
propel our customers in meeting their environmental, social and governance commitments.

### Measurably advance your ESG outcomes

**How Ingredion can help:**
* Collaborate to identify and prioritize your sustainability initiatives because what matters to
  you, matters to us
* Help execute on your ESG goals, measure progress and report meaningful advancements to your
  stakeholders
* Sustainably deliver products with the taste, texture and benefits consumers prefer

[Learn more][4]

[Picture 735315543]

## Our expertise

Ingredion is much more than a supplier. A partnership with us will enable you to increase speed to
market with high-quality, value-added products that consumers want.

[none, Picture]

Our portfolio of science-backed solutions for enhancing nutrition, delivering health benefits and
enabling wellness lifestyle choices is designed to help brands and manufacturers deliver winning
consumer products.

prefer.

help customers bring products with consumer-preferred taste, texture and nutrition to market.

[Learn more][8]

Ingredion’s consultative taste solution helps food and beverage manufacturers enhance and balance
flavors while solving better-for-you product challenges.

[Learn more][9]

### Texturants and texture solutions

We combine our 100+ years of texturant know-how with our passion for food science and broadest
portfolio of texturizing solutions to help manufacturers achieve their formulation needs.

[Learn more][10]

### APIs

About

## AARTI DRUGS LTD.

Aarti Drugs Ltd. was established in the year 1984 and forms part of $900 Million Aarti Group of
Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.
* The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharma
  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.
* Products under APIs includes Ciprofloxacin Hydrochloride, Metronidazole, Metformin HCL,
  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,
  Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride, Methyl Nicotinate etc.

Essential Medicines for animals.

What animal diseases can abendazole be used for?

elephants, and poultry. It is a medication that is widely used for the treatment of a variety of
parasitic worm infestations. Although Albendazole is mainly used in cattle and sheep, it is found
effective in cats and dogs as well. It is also used in ratite birds and swine to flagellate
parasites and tapeworms.

Albendazole is anthelmintic for veterinary use in cattle, sheep, goats, swine, camels, dogs, cats,
elephants, and poultry. It is a medication that is widely used for the treatment of a variety of
parasitic worm infestations. Although Albendazole is mainly used in cattle and sheep, it is found
effective in cats and dogs as well. It is also used in ratite birds and swine to flagellate
parasites and tapeworms.

Can albendazole be used to treat human diseases?

Albendazole is a medical drug administered as an effective treatment for infections caused by
flatworms, tapeworms, hookworms, etc. in humans. Albendazole is effective in treating many diseases.
It is FDA-approved for treating hydatid disease caused by dog tapeworm larvae and neurocysticercosis
caused by pork tapeworm larvae.

What are the benefits of albendazole for human health?

Albendazole is an anthelmintic or anti-worm medication. It is administered to prevent newly hatched
insect larvae (worms) from growing or multiplying in the human body. Albendazole is used to treat
certain infections caused by worms such as pork tapeworm. Albendazole is effective if taken after
eating sufficient food. Albendazole needs to be taken for the full prescribed length of time, even
if a patient feels health improvement. Skipping doses is not advisable and can increase the risk of
infection that resists the medication. Albendazole does not treat the flu or a common cold.

What grades of albendazole can Acewell Pharma manufacture?

Acewell Pharma has focused on the manufacturing of Bulk Drug API (Active Pharmaceutical
Ingredients). We have state-of-the-art equipment to develop and optimize the production process. Our
Albendazole API is highly cost-efficient. We manufacture Albendazole API as per IP/BP/ EP/ USP
standards, for veterinary and human use. ﻿Having over a decade of experience, Acewell Pharma is one
of the leading Albendazole API Powder manufacturing companies in China. We abide by the fact that
providing quality healthcare is an essential part of life and not a privilege. We offer world class
quality APIs at reasonable prices. ﻿As a Bulk Drug API Manufacturer, our aim is to create healthy
world by providing essential active pharmaceutical ingredient.

What is annual production capacity of Acewell Pharma?

Annual production of 100 tons of ivermectin, 10 tons of acetamiprid, 500 tons of albendazole, 50
tons of trimethoprim, 50 tons of trimethoprim phosphate, 50 tons of tetrahydropalmatine
hydrochloride, and other products

After the order, how long can you deliver the goods?

While nature has provided the foundation for modern medicine, it wasn’t designed to meet the scale

reliant on fragile agricultural sources with low predictability, resulting in drug shortages that
ultimately impact patient care.

and demand of 21st century healthcare needs.

predictability, resulting in drug shortages that ultimately impact patient care.

## We manufacture essential medicines

biosynthetic Key Starting Materials (KSMs) and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) for
essential medicines in a more efficient, agile, and sustainable approach. Advanced biosynthesis will
transform pharmaceutical supply chains and unlock new opportunities in drug development and
discovery.

### A revolutionary alternative to legacy approaches

The USDA cites that 40% of Western drugs are derived from plants. These medicines are sourced in an
agricultural process that is typically inefficient, inflexible, and highly susceptible to climate
events, inconsistent soil health, pests, and diseases. We need a more efficient, sustainable, and
reliable approach than legacy agricultural-based sources.

### Supply Chain

Agricultural sources can have unpredictable yields. Manufacturing in contained fermentation
environments offers a more reliable, controlled, and consistent supply.

### Resource Utilization

Agricultural-based manufacturing is inefficient and expensive. Purpose-built biomanufacturing
facilities reduce the need for agricultural sourcing and the associated costs, environmental
impacts, and long timelines.

### Novel Solution

Chemical synthesis is not suitable for KSMs and APIs of greater complexity. Advanced biosynthesis –
the leading 21st century technology – enables efficient biomanufacturing of pharma ingredients of
unprecedented complexity.

## Nature is our most powerful source of medicine

While nature has provided the foundation for modern medicine, it wasn’t designed to meet the scale
and demand of 21st century healthcare needs.

Today’s pharmaceutical supply chains are largely reliant on fragile agricultural sources with low
predictability, resulting in drug shortages that ultimately impact patient care.

## We manufacture essential medicines

Antheia’s biosynthesis platform leverages advanced manufacturing technologies to produce
biosynthetic Key Starting Materials (KSMs) and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) for
essential medicines in a more efficient, agile, and sustainable approach. Advanced biosynthesis will
transform pharmaceutical supply chains and unlock new opportunities in drug development and
discovery.

### A revolutionary alternative to legacy approaches

The USDA cites that 40% of Western drugs are derived from plants. These medicines are sourced in an
agricultural process that is typically inefficient, inflexible, and highly susceptible to climate
events, inconsistent soil health, pests, and diseases. We need a more efficient, sustainable, and
reliable approach than legacy agricultural-based sources.

### Supply Chain

Agricultural sources can have unpredictable yields. Manufacturing in contained fermentation
environments offers a more reliable, controlled, and consistent supply.

### Resource Utilization

Agricultural-based manufacturing is inefficient and expensive. Purpose-built biomanufacturing
facilities reduce the need for agricultural sourcing and the associated costs, environmental
impacts, and long timelines.

### Novel Solution

Chemical synthesis is not suitable for KSMs and APIs of greater complexity. Advanced biosynthesis –
the leading 21st century technology – enables efficient biomanufacturing of pharma ingredients of
unprecedented complexity.

## Explore Our Core Ingredients

### [Thickeners][113]

Add texture and body to your recipes naturally. Our plant-based thickeners like guar gum and xanthan
gum are ideal for soups, sauces, gravies, and gluten-free baking.

### [Stabilizers][114]

Keep your emulsions, foams, and frozen treats stable and smooth. Our hydrocolloid stabilizers
prevent separation and ensure consistent results every time.

### [Emulsifiers][115]

Get perfect blends with natural emulsifiers that help oil and water mix beautifully—ideal for
dressings, sauces, and dairy-free recipes.

### [Gelling Agents][116]

Create gels with precision. From firm jelly to elastic textures, our agar agar, carrageenan, and
other gelling agents offer full control.

### [Free Recipe Books][117]

Discover our collection of free recipe books featuring creative uses for thickeners, stabilizers,
and specialty powders. Download instantly and start cooking with confidence.

### [Specialty Powders][118]

Elevate your creations with unique flavor and nutrition. Explore our banana powder, vinegar powder,
and more for chefs and innovators alike.

## Explore Our Core Ingredients

### [Thickeners][113]

Add texture and body to your recipes naturally. Our plant-based thickeners like guar gum and xanthan
gum are ideal for soups, sauces, gravies, and gluten-free baking.

### [Stabilizers][114]

Keep your emulsions, foams, and frozen treats stable and smooth. Our hydrocolloid stabilizers
prevent separation and ensure consistent results every time.

### [Emulsifiers][115]

Get perfect blends with natural emulsifiers that help oil and water mix beautifully—ideal for
dressings, sauces, and dairy-free recipes.

### [Gelling Agents][116]

Create gels with precision. From firm jelly to elastic textures, our agar agar, carrageenan, and
other gelling agents offer full control.

### [Free Recipe Books][117]

Discover our collection of free recipe books featuring creative uses for thickeners, stabilizers,
and specialty powders. Download instantly and start cooking with confidence.

### [Specialty Powders][118]

Elevate your creations with unique flavor and nutrition. Explore our banana powder, vinegar powder,
and more for chefs and innovators alike.

# Plant based ingredients

# Upcycling nature’s gifts into valuable solutions for the food and beverage industry

**Citrus pectin.** A highly versatile and valuable natural dietary fiber, recognised by consumers as
a label-friendly ingredient. It serves as gelling, thickening and stabilising agent in food,
beverages, cosmetics, nutraceuticals and pharma. 

[ Find more ][66]

**Citrus fiber.** A clean label, plant-based ingredient delivering multiple functional and dietary
benefits. It is derived from partially depectinised citrus peels, making it a perfect example of a
circular economy.

[ Find more ][67]

**Tara gum.** A natural ingredient with excellent thickening and stabilising properties. It is
obtained by grinding the seeds of Caesalpinia spinosa, sourced from a sustainable and strictly
controlled supply chain.

[ Find more ][68]

**Tailor-made texturising solutions.** Blends of carefully selected stabilisers, thickeners and
other special ingredients designed to achieve distinctive textures, ensure good stability and
enhance mouthfeel in food and beverages.

# Upcycling nature’s gifts into valuable solutions for the food and beverage industry

**Citrus pectin.** A highly versatile and valuable natural dietary fiber, recognised by consumers as
a label-friendly ingredient. It serves as gelling, thickening and stabilising agent in food,
beverages, cosmetics, nutraceuticals and pharma. 

[ Find more ][66]

**Citrus fiber.** A clean label, plant-based ingredient delivering multiple functional and dietary
benefits. It is derived from partially depectinised citrus peels, making it a perfect example of a
circular economy.

[ Find more ][67]

**Tara gum.** A natural ingredient with excellent thickening and stabilising properties. It is
obtained by grinding the seeds of Caesalpinia spinosa, sourced from a sustainable and strictly
controlled supply chain.

[ Find more ][68]

**Tailor-made texturising solutions.** Blends of carefully selected stabilisers, thickeners and
other special ingredients designed to achieve distinctive textures, ensure good stability and
enhance mouthfeel in food and beverages.

China）”依托深厚的行业积淀、前瞻的国际视野和独特的创新基因，持续引领产业发展。展会携手同期举办的“世

China）”在构建全产业链生态体系的同时，还将通过前沿技术展示、深度思想碰撞和高效资源对接，为企业创造宝
贵的商业价值和战略机遇，为制药产业发展持续注入新动能。

2026年6月16-18日，CPHI
China将于上海新国际博览中心再启新程。届时，制药行业巨头、权威科研机构和资深从业人士将齐聚一堂，共同
探索医药产业创新发展新路径，推动中国医药创新成果走向世界舞台。

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."

to make their calls?
*It's right here.*

DrugPatentWatch pulls directly from primary sources — the USPTO, FDA Orange Book, ANDA filings,

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

drink value chain — from ingredients and processing to packaging, logistics, automation, and

growth. With in-depth features, expert commentary, and real-time updates, FDBusiness delivers the
knowledge that drives smarter, safer, and more sustainable operations worldwide.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

**Conference Benefits:**

•   Live Sessions

•   Meet your Academic idols
•   Hear about latest research
•   Engage in High level debates & Q/A
•   Networking for future collaboration

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ProFood International, Inc.  is a U.S. based food additive distributor who has the                  
[**manufacturing** ][7] bases in United States and in Asia specializing in natural antimicrobials,  
texturizers and specialty sweeteners. The high quality products are manufactured in ISO 9002, HACCP.
GMP and Kosher certified facilities.                                                                
                                                                                                    
ProFood has been serving food, neutraceutical and pharmaceutical industries since 1998. Our Sales   
and Customer Support Office are in Naperville, IL. We maintain product warehousing through various  
regions within the U.S to facilitate prompt shipping within the US, Canada and South America.       
                                                                                                    
More info can be found in the Profood [Products][8] list and [Technical][9] and [Application][10]   
bulletins. Should you have questions on our growing ingredient offerings and our stringent  quality 
assurance regimen, don’t hesitate to [contact us][11]. We’d be more than happy to provide additional

Als **Erfinder der Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) Technologie** ist Rommelag Ihr zuverlässiger
One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren
leistungs­starken bottelpack Abfüllanlagen bieten wir Lohnabfüll­dienst­leistungen, Unterstützung bei
der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

# Leading Global Pharmaceutical Company

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is committed to being the world’s leading manufacturer and
exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce
necessary drugs that are affordable, easily available, and effective.

## We are offering
## best Services & Products

High-quality pharmaceutical, ayurvedic, and antibiotic medications are available from Salvavidas
Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They
guarantee on-time delivery and keep their prices competitive. Salvavidas Pharmaceutical puts the
needs of its patients first by improving safety, efficacy, convenience, and compliance while
offering reasonably priced goods that benefit both patients and society as a whole.
* 
  
  We Committed to Quality Products
* 
  
  WHO-GMP & ISO Certified Facilities

## We Committed for a Better Life

### Salvavidas pharma is a leading pharmaceutical manufacturing and export company in India

We place a high priority on customer happiness, which we accomplish by offering high-quality
medicines on schedule and at fair prices. We promise that every product meets the highest caliber
throughout its development, manufacturing, sale, distribution, etc. We are dedicated to establishing
and preserving solid bonds with our clients worldwide. As a result, we are now recognized as a
reliable exporter offering service globally.

## What we bring to you

Salvavidas Pharma is a well-known Indian pharmaceutical exporter that provides a wide variety of
medications to international markets. The organization, which is based in Surat, Gujarat, is one of
the greatest places to find pharmaceutical items. It provides a wide range of products that are
developed to fulfill the requirements of its customers, such as antimalarials, analgesics, and
antibiotics. Salvavidas Pharma, which has a large worldwide presence, focuses on public health as a
driver for social and economic advancement. It is currently one of the leading pharmaceutical firms
in India. 

[Manufacturing and Export Company][Manufacturing and Export Company]

## Worldwide Reach

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. exports to more than 40 nations across five continents: Africa,
South-East Asia, Latin America, North America, and the CIS region. We are an Indian manufacturer and
exporter of all pharmaceutical items with more than 500 product registrations worldwide.

70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)

the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

### About Virchow

Virchow Group comprises of six independent active pharmaceutical ingredient (API), one
bio-pharmaceutical and two drug intermediate companies. All these companies function
independently with their own management structures.

Incorporated in 1981, the flagship company of the group, Virchow Laboratories Limited is
today the largest producer of Sulfamethoxazole in the world.  In fact, Virchow Group services
more than 80% of the worldwide Sulfamethoxazole requirement. Other group companies are
world leading manufacturers of Cephalosporin’s, Tramadol and various other
APIs and bio-pharmaceutical Finished Dosage Forms (FDF’s). Virchow also undertakes
custom synthesis and manufacture of drug intermediates and bulk chemicals.

### Our Products

[ Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients ][51]

[ Intermediates ][52]

[ Bulk Chemicals ][53]

[ Finished Dosage Forms- Specialities ][54]

[ Finished Dosage Forms - Classicals ][55]

### Our Products

##### Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients

Active pharmaceutical ingredients or APIs can be defined as the chemicals used to manufacture
pharmaceutical drugs.

##### Intermediates

Commercial terminology used for Direct Compressible (DC). It comprises a mixture of active
substances and excipients, usually in powder form

##### Finished Dosage Forms - Special

Virchows integrated product development and manufacturing model includes a range of finished oral
solid dosage forms

##### Bulk Chemicals

A group of chemicals that are made on a very large scale to satisfy global markets, The chemistry
and processes used to create organic commodity chemicals

##### Pipeline APIs

Set of drug candidates that a pharmaceutical company has under discovery or development at any given
point in time.

##### Finished Dosage Forms-Classicals

Virchows integrated product development and manufacturing model includes a range of finished oral
solid dosage forms

### Our Management

Dr. N. Venkata Reddy
Managing Director (Commercial)

Dr. N. Venkata Reddy is a medical doctor and passed his MBBS from Andhra University in 1968.  After
a few years of medical practice, he started Virchow Laboratories Limited along with Mr. Narayana
Reddy in 1983. 

Mr. M. Narayana Reddy
Managing Director (Technical)

Mr. M. Narayana Reddy is a post graduate in Organic Chemistry from Sri Venkateswara University in
1976.  After having an experience of about 7 years in R&D and production in a couple of bulk drug
units, he started Virchow Laboratories Limited in 1983. 

Mr. Prasanth Nandigala
Director

Mr. Prasanth Nandigala completed his B. Tech in Chemical Engineering from Indian Institute of
Technology, Mumbai and MS in Chemical Engineering from Iowa State University, Ames, Iowa, USA. He
later did his MBA in Finance from Indiana University, Bloomington, USA . 

Mr. Mundla Vishnu
Director

Mr. Maha Vishnu Mundla is a graduate in Chemical Engineering, and has done his Masters in Business
Administration from USA with specialization in finance and marketing. He is looking after Virchow
Group's new business development, marketing and strategy.

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

Type B (Phuket).

manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
